sv.title: Fed-chef: Flera höjningar innan våren kan behövas
sv.summary: Federal Reserve kan behöva höja räntan flera gånger före våren 2027 för att få inflationen under kontroll. Det sa Alberto Musalem, Fed-chef i St Louis, enligt Bloomberg News.

en.title: Fed chief: Several rate hikes may be needed before spring
en.summary: The Federal Reserve may need to raise interest rates several times before spring 2027 to bring inflation under control. This is what Alberto Musalem, Fed chief in St Louis, said according to Bloomberg News.
